about.title: About ArtAqua
body: ArtAqua is a brand of PostModerna, one of the first companies in Macedonia specialized in designer bathroom equipment, import, trade and installation.
Since 1997, the company has successfully operated on the Macedonian market and has become a recognizable brand offering high-quality services.
The modern design and high quality of the products reflect the goal of following the latest European trends while offering modern, functional and reliable bathroom solutions.
about.brands: The product range includes renowned Italian, Slovenian and Croatian manufacturers, including CERAMICA GRAVENA, GSG, HATRIA, FRIGES, REMER, FIORE, EFFEPI, KOLPA, REFLEX, ARMAL, UNITAS HERC, MINES and AQUAESTIL.
about.imageAlt: Part of the ArtAqua showroom with sanitary equipment and bathroom furniture

services.title: Our services
services.description: From product selection to installation and complete execution, ArtAqua connects bathroom equipment with practical solutions.
body: Professional service and strong technical knowledge of the products are key characteristics of the ArtAqua brand.
For products bought in the showroom, ArtAqua offers free delivery to your home in Skopje and professional installation.
In addition to sales and installation, the company can carry out the complete process of bathroom reconstruction in all of its stages.
ArtAqua installs hydro and aero massage systems and additional acrylic bath tub equipment such as underwater spotlights, heaters, chromotherapy and electronic displays.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: How we handle personal data when you visit the ArtAqua website or contact the showroom.

sections.title: Who operates this website
paragraphs: PostModerna operates the bathroom and sanitary equipment showroom website under its public-facing brand, ArtAqua. Our showroom address and email addresses are listed below.

sections.title: What we collect and why
paragraphs: When you use the contact form, we receive your first and last names, email address, message and, if you choose to provide it, your phone number. The form also records the submission time and the website language in the email it sends to us.

We use this information to respond to your enquiry, provide the product or service information you request, and follow up on your request. The form is optional. You can also contact us directly by email or visit the showroom.

sections.title: Legal basis
paragraphs: Under Article 10 of North Macedonia's Law on Personal Data Protection, the legal basis depends on the purpose of the processing. For an enquiry about a possible purchase or service, processing may be necessary to take steps you request before entering into a contract.

For general correspondence, handling and responding to enquiries may be a legitimate interest where the processing is necessary and your rights and interests do not override that interest. We may also process information where necessary to meet a legal obligation. Sending an enquiry is not treated as consent for unrelated uses.

sections.title: How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep enquiry correspondence only as long as needed to handle your request and any related follow-up. Information may be kept longer where necessary to meet applicable record-keeping obligations or to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

sections.title: Who handles your information
paragraphs: Our hosting provider delivers the website and processes web requests, including contact form submissions. When the website is hosted on Vercel, Vercel provides that infrastructure and may process technical request data such as IP addresses.

The contact form uses Gmail SMTP (Google) to deliver submissions to the business by email. Staff handling enquiries may access the correspondence to respond. The site does not store submissions in a separate website database.

sections.title: International processing
paragraphs: Hosting and email providers may process information outside North Macedonia, depending on their services and deployment settings. You can contact us to ask about the locations and safeguards applicable to any transfer of your personal data.

sections.title: Cookies, maps and social links
paragraphs: The website does not include its own analytics or advertising trackers. It may use browser local storage for the light or dark display preference.

The contact page embeds Google Maps. When the map loads, your browser connects to Google. Google may receive technical information such as your IP address and browser details, and may use cookies or similar technologies.
Instagram and Facebook are links, not embedded feeds. Those platforms handle information under their own privacy policies when you follow the links.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to be informed about processing, access your personal data and have inaccurate data corrected. Where the legal conditions are met, you can request erasure, restriction or portability, or object to processing. You also have the right, where applicable, not to be subject to solely automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects.

You can use the contact details below to exercise your rights. If you believe your right to personal data protection has been violated, you can submit a request to the Personal Data Protection Agency of North Macedonia, the supervisory authority.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.intro: These terms apply to use of the ArtAqua showroom website, operated by PostModerna.

sections.title: Catalogue and enquiries
paragraphs: This website is an informational catalogue for the ArtAqua bathroom and sanitary equipment showroom. It shows product categories and galleries and provides ways to contact the business.
There is no online ordering, shopping cart, checkout or online payment. Sending a contact form message is an enquiry; it does not place an order or create a purchase contract by itself.

sections.title: Product information and availability
paragraphs: Descriptions, gallery images and other catalogue information are illustrative. Colours, finishes, dimensions or included items may vary by product. Confirm exact specifications, availability, price and any service arrangements directly with ArtAqua before making a purchase.

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: Site text, branding, photographs and other materials may be protected by intellectual property rights belonging to ArtAqua, PostModerna or the relevant third-party rights holder. You may browse the site for information and share links to public pages. Permission is needed to copy, republish or use protected materials commercially unless the law permits the use.

sections.title: Appropriate use
paragraphs: Use the website lawfully and respect other people's rights. Do not send spam or unlawful material through the contact form, impersonate another person, or interfere with the operation or security of the website.

sections.title: External links and services
paragraphs: The site links to external services such as Instagram and Facebook and embeds Google Maps for the showroom location. Those services have their own terms and privacy policies.

sections.title: Changes and legal rights
paragraphs: We may update the catalogue, other website content or these terms from time to time. An update to the site does not change an existing purchase agreement by itself.
Nothing in these terms limits any mandatory consumer rights or legal protections, or excludes responsibilities that cannot be limited by law.

termsOfUse.contactNote: Contact the showroom to confirm product details or ask a question about these terms.

returnsRefunds.title: Returns & Refunds
returnsRefunds.intro: Information about purchases made directly with the ArtAqua showroom and how to raise a return, refund or warranty question.

sections.title: Purchases are arranged directly
paragraphs: This website does not accept online orders or payments and has no checkout. A message sent through the contact form is an enquiry, not a completed purchase. Purchases and related arrangements are handled directly with the business.

sections.title: Returns, exchanges, refunds and warranty
paragraphs: Contact ArtAqua / PostModerna with questions about a return, exchange, refund, warranty or product problem. The applicable steps may depend on the type of purchase, the product, the transaction documents and the law. A receipt or invoice and product details can help us identify your purchase, if available.

sections.title: Defective or non-conforming products
paragraphs: Requests about defective products or goods that do not conform to the contract are handled under applicable North Macedonian consumer protection legislation, including the Law on Consumer Protection, as amended. The available remedies depend on the circumstances and the applicable law.

link.label: Law on Consumer Protection (original text, PDF in Macedonian)

sections.title: Distance and off-premises contracts
paragraphs: Where a transaction qualifies as a distance contract or an off-premises contract, the statutory right of withdrawal applies where the law provides for it, subject to the relevant conditions and exceptions. This is not a general return promise for all purchases.
Nothing on this page limits your statutory consumer rights.
